name: Malbolge
title: Malbolge: The Sixth Layer
description: Malbolge is the sixth layer of the Nine Hells, a land formed from the remains of its former ruler, the Hag Countess.
wiki: Malbolge is now ruled by Glasya, the daughter of Asmodeus. The landscape is a twisted maze of bone and flesh, filled with prisons and places of punishment.
